concern_results.conclusion: Quiet now requires covered (moves_head=0, worktree_clean, commit-or-tree equality — logically equivalent to the two old quiet branches) AND status exactly "passed"; the covered non-passed branch sets its own note/message and the uncovered assignment is guarded by [ "$covered" != 1 ] so neither overwrites the other; review_gate.py adds complete to anchors_wanted under the unchanged --base/no --paths gate and records only on the fully assembled success result after the failure branch returned, matching the plan's decision table row by row.

No credential, egress, packet, or permission boundary changes; receipt content flows only through jq --arg into agent-context JSON and is never executed; the printed path is the local git-dir receipt path the hook already computed; the controller write reuses the existing anchored no-follow receipt writer; the reminder stays non-blocking.

Missing/malformed receipt still degrades to silence via the hex guard and || true; a missing status reads "?" and reminds (fail-safe direction, not reported as findings); a failed completion returns rc 2 before the record call with the receipt pinned byte-identical; a dirty-at-completion receipt carries worktree_clean=false which the hook never treats as quiet; a HEAD-moving command forces covered=0 so the prior reminder still fires.

Both changed properties have killing mutations: status-predicate removal fails exactly the four status fixtures and reverting the completion write fails exactly the completion-success case; the new hook probes are RED on the unfixed hook while passed-on-covered stays green; failed-completion byte-identity is pinned by cmp -s; the dispositions-entry receipt case on a committed --base candidate is added in test_review_client_compat.py and fails against the prior controller with the receipt still (challenge, findings).

Receipt schema unchanged; pre-existing findings receipts covering HEAD now remind, which is the declared correction; coverage fixtures moved from a hard-coded findings status to a passed default so they keep testing coverage rather than disposition; hook JSON consumers see only added message text.
Single-commit revert restores prior behavior; the reminder never denies or asks so a false reminder cannot block a command; no migration, state conversion, or irreversible step is introduced.

All four reminder forms (no receipt, covered non-passed, uncovered HEAD, HEAD-moving) name the receipt path read, and the covered non-passed message carries mode, status and recorded_at so the exact artifact can be opened instead of inferring a path mismatch.

Claims stay within the suites run; the single load-related make test exit 2 (abort-leak wrapper alive at 55s) is disclosed with isolated re-runs green rather than asserted as a pass, and the deferred gaps (dispositions-file entry not exercised end to end, uncovered-template path fragment without a dedicated probe) are disclosed; evidence counts are consistent with the fixtures as far as the bounded packet allows verification.

Shared-gate change is contained: the hook remains advisory and the controller change appends one receipt write to an existing success path without touching verdict, budget, chain, completion-success criteria, or authorization logic; both changed behaviors have killing mutations and the failure path leaves prior receipt state untouched.

hooks/AGENTS.md non-wording rule is met by the deterministic suite plus recorded independent review and adversarial challenge, with advisory-vs-blocking kept explicit in the header; root AGENTS.md baseline-then-RED and scope rules hold; backticked specs/ tokens in the new markdown resolve to files added in the same diff; the late charter and non-prescribed review entry are self-disclosed in extraction-closeout.md with a pending human decision, which the intent/evidence declares; no contract file is modified or loosened and no quoted rule is defective or contradictory.
